---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a bounded, user-facing improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## User need

Describe the user workflow or problem this would improve.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful behavior, including the relevant workbench and commands.

## Authoritative state

Identify which native FreeCAD document object, Sketcher source, semantic record, or derived state should remain authoritative.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The behavior is deterministic and fail-closed where validation is required.
- [ ] A focused automated assertion covers the intended behavior.
- [ ] A FreeCAD/Xvfb visual fixture is added or extended for user-visible geometry/UI changes.
- [ ] Save/reload and invalidation behavior are considered where persistent state changes.
- [ ] Existing validation thresholds are not weakened.

## Alternatives considered

Describe relevant alternatives or why the proposed boundary is preferred.

## Remaining limitations

List intentionally deferred or roadmap behavior. Do not claim commercial feature parity unless it is implemented and tested.
